reasons.plausibility: While not scientifically incorrect, the proposal does not directly address the specific EAM-to-ab initio liquid-reference mismatch and lacks details on how CALPHAD would resolve it.
reasons.testability: A comparison of predicted vs. measured phases is feasible, but the falsification criterion is vague about the free-energy benchmark relative to EAM references.
reasons.usefulness: Although CALPHAD can aid high-temperature alloy design, it offers limited utility in addressing the question of how to improve phase-space overlap with ab initio liquids in EAM references.
